title: Himachal Pradesh Tour Package
overview: Breathe in crisp cedar mountain air on this 6-day holiday. Drive through the historic Atal Tunnel into Lahaul’s Sissu waterfalls, soar on paragliders in Solang, and relax in scenic wooden chalets amidst apple orchards in Manali.
highlights: 3 Nights in Manali + 1 Night in Shimla + 1 Night in Kasol / Kullu
Drive through engineering wonder Atal Tunnel to Sissu, Lahaul Valley
Solang Valley adventure sports and snow activities
River rafting in Beas river, Kullu
Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali cafes
inclusions: 5 Nights stay in handpicked 3★/4★ mountain resorts
Daily Breakfast & Dinner at all hotels
Dedicated private AC/Heated Sedan/Innova for entire tour
All toll, fuel, parking, and driver allowances
exclusions: Adventure activities fees (paragliding, rafting, quad bikes)
Rohtang Pass NGT green permit taxi if opted

itinerary.title: Delhi/Chandigarh to Shimla (Queen of Hills)
itinerary.description: Pickup from Delhi/Chandigarh and scenic highway drive through the Shivalik hills to Shimla. Check into hotel and stroll on the historic Mall Road and Ridge.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Walk along the Ridge, Christ Church and Mall Road

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Kullu Valley & Pandoh Dam
itinerary.description: Drive from Shimla to Manali (approx. 7 hrs) along the Beas River. Stop at Pandoh Dam, Hanogi Mata temple, and Kullu Shawl weaving factory. Arrive in Manali by evening.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Pandoh dam view & Kullu shawl factory visit
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in to Manali apple orchard resort & dinner
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure & Atal Tunnel to Sissu Waterfall
itinerary.description: Head to Solang Valley for paragliding, zorbing, and ropeway. Cross through the 9.02 km Atal Tunnel to enter the dramatic trans-Himalayan landscape of Sissu in Lahaul Valley.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Atal Tunnel drive to Sissu waterfall and snow points
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to Manali for campfire and hot buffet
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing: Hadimba, Vashisht & Old Manali
itinerary.description: Visit the 500-year-old wooden Hadimba Devi Temple in deep cedar woods, holy Vashisht Hot Sulphur Springs, Club House, and cozy bohemian cafes of Old Manali.
itinerary.morningActivity: Hadimba Temple and Van Vihar pine forest walk
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Vashisht hot springs and Tibetan Monastery
itinerary.eveningActivity: Cafe hopping in Old Manali & wood-fired pizza
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol Parvati Valley & Manikaran Sahib
itinerary.description: Drive to the scenic Parvati Valley. Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara known for its natural hot springs and langar. Relax in the picturesque riverside village of Kasol.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Parvati Valley with Kullu Beas river rafting
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and hot spring dip
itinerary.eveningActivity: Riverside chill at Kasol and Israeli cuisine dinner
itinerary.stay: The River Crescent / Kasol Riverside Camp 4★

itinerary.title: Kasol to Chandigarh / Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast with river sounds before driving back to Chandigarh/Delhi airport or railway station.

faqs.question: Is there a Manali tour package from Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes. This package picks you up in Delhi or Chandigarh and drops you back at the end, so the road journey both ways is already part of it. Travel is by private AC vehicle with a mountain driver, and fuel, tolls, parking, permits and the driver's allowances are included. If you would rather come by Volvo bus and start the tour in Manali, we can quote that version instead.

faqs.question: Is this Manali package suitable for a family?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the trips families book most. Stays are 3-star or 4-star mountain resorts with breakfast and dinner, and the sightseeing days cover Solang Valley, Hadimba Temple, Vashisht and Old Manali at an unhurried pace. Travelling with elderly parents or small children is fine - tell us and we will space out the driving days and pick hotels with easier access.

faqs.question: Is this a good Manali package for a couple or honeymoon?
faqs.answer: It works well for couples. Transport is a private vehicle rather than a shared coach, the resorts sit among the apple orchards rather than on the main road, and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu day is the one most couples remember. For a honeymoon we can add a candlelight dinner, room decoration or a premium cottage - ask when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can I get a Manali package with flights included?
faqs.answer: This package is priced without airfare, because most travellers on it drive up from Delhi or Chandigarh. If you would prefer to fly, we can quote a version with tickets to Bhuntar (Kullu) or Chandigarh plus the road transfer to Manali. Bhuntar is the closer airport but its flights are weather-dependent in winter, so we usually plan Chandigarh with a road leg for anything between December and February.

faqs.question: Can a solo traveller book this Manali package?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we will customise it rather than sell you a group seat. A solo booking is quoted on single occupancy, so the per-person price differs from the twin-sharing rate shown here - the room is the main reason. You can bring the cost down with a smaller vehicle or a simpler hotel category. Tell us your budget and we will build to it.

faqs.question: Do you have a 2 days 1 night Manali package?
faqs.answer: We can arrange one, but it is a different trip from this one. Manali is roughly 12 to 14 hours by road from Delhi, so a 2-day plan spends most of its time travelling and leaves you about half a day on the ground. If your dates are tight, a 4-night trip starting from Chandigarh is the shortest version we would actually recommend. This 6-day itinerary exists because it lets you see Shimla, Manali, Sissu and Kasol without rushing any of them.

faqs.question: Is this Manali package good for a friends group?
faqs.answer: Yes. Solang Valley covers paragliding, zorbing and the ropeway, the Atal Tunnel drive into Lahaul is the highlight of the trip, and Kasol and Parvati Valley are on the way back. Adventure activities are charged on the spot by the operators rather than bundled in, so you only pay for what your group actually does. For six or more people we switch to a tempo traveller, which usually lowers the per-head cost.

faqs.question: What does a Manali package actually cost?
faqs.answer: This one starts at Rs 14,499 per person on twin sharing, for 5 nights with breakfast, dinner and a private vehicle throughout. The final figure moves with your travel dates, hotel category, group size and vehicle - peak season, New Year and the summer holidays are the dearest. Packages advertised at Rs 5,000 or so are usually 2-day trips on a shared bus with basic rooms and no meals, which is a different product; we would rather tell you that than surprise you later. Send us your dates and headcount and you will get an itemised quote.
